facts.notes: All represented STEP components, including open shells, retain their original millimetre assembly positions. Any omitted optional attachment is individually recorded; original STEP bytes remain complete. No nonuniform scaling or inferred circuit placement is applied. CAD authoring date and Git commit date are source dates, not a claim of product release date. RESET remains visible geometry only; platform reset is a separate action. The live framebuffer overlays the native active face by 0.008 mm for rendering; this offset is not a physical laminate thickness. Source photographs are unchanged references. Review registration and material colors do not certify mechanical fit, optical text-to-USB calibration or hidden dimensions. Native components are not Boolean-unioned; any source assembly overlaps remain as supplied. The STEP is an internal board/display assembly and contains no black enclosure. This model intentionally presents that internal assembly. Shipping enclosure, battery and camera accessories have not been reconstructed or certified. SKU35417 is the no-camera package with battery; 35416 (-EN) omits the battery. SKU35419 (-C) and 35418 (-C-EN) add a camera. These packaging facts do not certify common hidden geometry. No battery or camera is invented here. The 63.67×95.11 mm housing and 13.50/14.10 mm depth annotations are from the official camera -C dimension image. They are recorded separately and are not substituted for the native 61.00×92.44×13.40 mm internal assembly. PWR is source geometry only pending exact runtime control semantics. Source component801 AS-BD108A93D13-50 has a camera-lens/FPC shape and is omitted from this explicitly no-camera base SKU; adjacent central EVA foam806 is also omitted because its applicability without that attachment is unverified. This geometric/photo identification does not certify a camera chip part number. The source PMMA part name mentions P4; it is a reused mechanical part within the newly published assembly explicitly named ESP32-C5-TOUCH-LCD-3_5_ASM, not evidence of a P4 circuit.

collectionNotes: 原厂 ROM 在第 6831 条指令读取 PMU 0x600b00e4 时停止；原始 FactoryOnly 镜像独立保持 reference。
原创 SRAM 诊断已原生验证完整 8 MiB PSRAM、GDMA 出屏、FT6336 输入、BOOT 与 SD 块保存／读写／恢复；此记录不替代公开 Worker 或浏览器验收。
物理模块为 32 MiB Flash、8 MiB PSRAM；PWR 属于外部电源／CH32 电路，不映射为普通 GPIO。
CH32V006 初始方向／输出保持未知，ADC／RTC 固件命令不支持；QMI8658 物理 A/C 后缀未证实。
AXP USB 无电池数字电源场景；模拟充电、温湿度、音频、相机、无线、物理颜色／扫描／PWM 校准和 FAT 挂载尚未验收。
Physical16-bit CH32V006 vs8-bit V003-named factory component; low-byte accesses coexist with separately sourced16-bit LE protocol, upper startup bits stay unknown.
Schematic/README QMI8658 has no suffix; A PDF and qmi8658c example disagree on reserved controls. Strict shared A/C intersection only; no physical C identity claim.
Arduino16MiB menu is not physical capacity; current factory really uses32MiB.
Base SKU35417 无摄像头；-EN35416、-C35419、-C-EN35418 为官方列出的包装／相机差异。本 profile 不声称相机能力。
机械模型由独立资料与模型 lane 维护；此生成器保留已有 model／dimensions／model-* 项，不从电气资料推造外形。
3D 来源：官方 CAD 机械参考。 生产加载器几何与输入射线已检查；浏览器 WebGL 和实物装配尚未验收。
官方 SKU 35417；套装选项：Without camera / With 3.7V Lithium Batt。电池与排针包装差异不代表额外固件或实机验收。
共用板型的既有测试只证明已建模数字接口；不继承任何真实硬件、摄像头、射频或电池验证。
官方 SKU 35416；套装选项：Without camera / Without Lithium Batt。电池与排针包装差异不代表额外固件或实机验收。
